jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking experienced and highly motivated Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to join our Cloud Infrastructure organization and drive the delivery of complex, high-impact infrastructure programs.

As Mistral continues to scale its AI compute infrastructure, bringing new capacity online quickly and reliably is critical to our success. This involves not only deploying physical infrastructure but also coordinating the engineering efforts required to make that infrastructure fully operational.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, software infrastructure, and data center deployments, ensuring seamless execution across multiple technical teams.

You will coordinate programs involving networking, storage, Kubernetes, fleet management, and infrastructure operations, working closely with engineering teams to manage dependencies, anticipate risks, and accelerate the deployment of production-ready compute capacity.

The TPM role spans several critical areas of program management:

Cloud Infrastructure Deployment – Coordinate the software deployment and bring-up of new compute infrastructure, ensuring smooth transitions from physical data center deployment to fully operational cloud environments.

Technical Program Management – Plan, execute, and oversee complex infrastructure programs involving multiple engineering teams, managing dependencies, timelines, and technical risks to ensure successful delivery.

Cross-Functional Engineering Coordination – Work closely with Cloud Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure, Networking, Storage, Kubernetes, and Fleet teams to align priorities, resolve blockers, and drive execution.

Engineering Operations & Process Improvement – Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure deployment processes, improve coordination, and introduce scalable, lightweight workflows that accelerate delivery.

Location & Office Policy

The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

jobs.description:
Ready to design products and services that make a difference?

Do you want to create products that make a meaningful impact? Are you ready to lead strategy and delivery on projects that reach large audiences?

 

If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. As a Product Manager, you’ll lead product strategy and delivery, balancing user needs and business goals across sectors, to create services that are used by millions of UK citizens.

 

The role 

You’ll work with technical teams and stakeholders to develop solutions that deliver our clients’ strategic goals. You'll work in agile teams alongside people in a range of roles spanning design, development, and research.

 

You’ll help deliver the vision, helping to decide the features that each product needs and manage backlogs to meet our client preferences. You'll deliver discovery and ideation workshops across diverse groups of stakeholders.

 

Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client. 

 

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site working. Applicants should be able to travel, as part of their daily commute, to client sites in one of the following locations: Newcastle, Leeds or Manchester.

 

We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

 

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process.

 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

 

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

 

We’re looking to welcome new team members for multiple roles from November onward. If you’re interested in joining Opencast, we’d encourage you to apply.

 

Essential experience

To succeed as a senior consultant product manager, you will need to demonstrate a breadth and depth of experience working in product management roles, on complex projects, across the full product lifecycle in different sectors.


You will have in-depth knowledge of software development, with experience in agile and user-centred design.


In your CV and the interview, you should show how you have:
  • Led cross-functional, agile teams to deliver successful products
  • Developed product visions, minimum viable products and roadmaps, understanding business problems and contexts
  • Communicated objectives, plans and progress to a range of stakeholders
  • Used boundary objects to synthesise many different perspectives
  • Facilitated conversations to align large groups of diverse stakeholders
  • Cultivated high performing, constructive and trusting team environments

 

With a significant proportion of our client base in the public sector, we are particularly interested in candidates with experience working in central or local government and/or the NHS.

 

Experience working to the GOV.UK Service Standards, including passing service standard assessments at different stages, is a desirable skill. If you have this experience, please demonstrate this on your CV to discuss at interview. 

 

Essential consulting skills

In addition to business analysis skills, there are essential core skills you’ll need to be an Opencast consultant. You’ll need to demonstrate how you:

  • Contribute to improving ways of working and driving continuous improvements within your teams.
  • Share knowledge and best practice with fellow product managers and other disciplines, including proactively engaging in client and Opencast communities of practice.
  • Positively challenge decisions or solutions you don’t agree with, striving for the best client outcomes.
  • Create lasting value in the projects you work on, ensuring a user-centric, sustainable approach.
  • Engage with Opencast in a meaningful way, supporting the growth of your practice and wider capability.
  • Support Opencast's growth plans, by providing case studies and updates into the relevant forums of your project work.

 

Salary

£60,000 - £70,000 per annum.

 

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations.  We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

 

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

 

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

 

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Core Experience Team 👋
The Core Experience team looks after how our customers find and book rail travel across the UK and Europe. Our work covers search, supply from carriers and the booking experience, all in service of our purpose of empowering greener travel choices and connecting people and places. We are a collaborative group who enjoy learning from our customers and from each other.

This is a brand new role, created to own what happens once a customer has found the right journey and moves towards booking: reservation details, optional extras and payment. Because it sits so close to the point of purchase, it offers a direct line to customer experience and revenue, and plenty of room to grow. You will work alongside our Search team and the Supply and Payments platform teams, with colleagues in commercial, design, data and engineering, to make booking simple and reliable for customers in every market we serve.

In this role as the Product Manager, Booking Conversion, you will...🚄

  • Own the customer experience from the moment someone chooses a journey to a confirmed booking, setting clear goals for conversion (the share of customers who complete their booking) and revenue while enabling other teams with a stake in the journey.

  • Run quick cycles of experimentation by forming hypotheses, testing ideas, learning from the results and iterating, while shaping a longer-term vision and roadmap for the booking journey.

  • Use customer insight and data to understand where people hesitate or leave, and decide where to invest limited team capacity across each step of the journey.

  • Build a deep understanding of how rail works in different markets and with different carriers. Decide when a market or carrier specific improvement is the right investment, and when to bring ideas and learnings together across markets so that value grows for customers everywhere, rather than staying in one place.

  • Balance wider business goals from other teams, such as adding new supply, increasing booking features for each carrier, and introducing optional extras and new revenue streams, against keeping the journey simple and low in friction for customers.

  • Partner closely with the Supply, Search, New Business, and Payments platform teams, alongside design, data and engineering, to align priorities and deliver improvements together.

  • Communicate openly with a wide range of stakeholders, including commercial colleagues, explaining the reasoning behind decisions and sharing progress and results in a way that builds trust.

  • Bring AI tools into your everyday work, such as prototyping, analysis and delivery, and help the team grow in confidence using them.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Experience improving conversion in a digital booking, checkout or purchase journey, using data to spot opportunities and measure the impact of your changes.

  • Hands-on experience designing and running experiments, and turning what you learn into the next set of improvements.

  • A customer-first mindset, with the ability to combine customer insight and data to make confident decisions even when information is incomplete.

  • Confidence setting direction for a product area, balancing near-term improvements with a longer-term vision.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication, with the ability to explain complex trade-offs and build alignment between teams who may have different priorities.

  • Comfort weighing limited capacity against competing demands, and explaining what you will focus on and why.

  • Ideally, experience balancing local needs with a wider shared strategy, for example across several markets or with third-party suppliers. It is also helpful if you are familiar with travel, ticketing or payments.

  • You may also be curious about AI tools and keen to use them to prototype ideas, analyse results and speed up delivery.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager LogicSteel Ben jij een ondernemende Product Manager die kansen ziet waar anderen ze nog niet zien? Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans!

 

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines.

 

In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen.

 

Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen.

 

Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:

  • doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;

  • bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;

  • vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;

  • identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;

  • bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;

  • opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;

  • intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;

  • bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;

  • bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling.

 

Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?

“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen!

 

Warm en professioneel bad

Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken.

 

Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.”

 

Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.”

 

Wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements;

  • Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken;

  • Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling;

  • Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants;

  • Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre;

  • Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal;

 

Wij bieden

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team;

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s;

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen.

Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! Wil jij eerst meer weten over de functie of Voortman Steel Machinery, neem dan contact op met Guus Regelink via ----- of bel/WhatsApp naar 0626393850. Twijfel je of jouw achtergrond aansluit bij de functie? Laat het dan vooral weten. Er is vaak meer mogelijk dan je denkt!

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

  • Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

  • Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

  • Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products


What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

  • Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

  • Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team (

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

We are seeking a strategic, people-focused Team Lead Functional Analyst to head our Functional Analysis & Process Design chapter within the Enterprise Applications & Integrations department. As tonies undergoes a company-wide transformation from a distributed landscape to a harmonized, global operating model powered by SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, our IT and business functions are moving toward a product-oriented organization.

In this pivotal role, you will provide horizontal leadership to our team of Functional Analysts -the vital translation bridge between our business value streams (Operations, Finance, Sales) and our technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes with a strong mentoring mindset, setting methodology standards and empowering the team to translate operational needs into scalable, standard-first enterprise solutions.

What you'll do

As Team Lead Functional Analyst, you will act as the Chapter Lead for Functional Analysis, providing both disciplinary leadership and methodological governance for your team.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Providing horizontal leadership to the Functional Analyst team, overseeing personal skill development, coaching, and managing capacity allocation across various value streams.

  • Methodology & Standards: Setting and enforcing best-practice methodology standards for the chapter, including process modeling (BPMN 2.0), agile requirements engineering, user story writing (Jira/Confluence), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) protocols.

  • Strategic Governance: Empowering your team to act as "The Bridge" that effectively translates business pain points into structured functional specification documents (FSDs) while strictly enforcing Fit-to-Standard and Clean Core principles to prevent unnecessary custom complexity.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering seamlessly with Business Product Owners (who prioritize the "WHAT & WHY"), SAP Consultants (The Solution), Solution Architects (The Gatekeepers), and App Engineers (The Build) to ensure a unified end-to-end delivery lifecycle.

  • Process Integrity: Ensuring your team upholds strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) guidelines and four-pillar controls during process design (e.g., keeping functional analysis strictly separated from system configuration, master data creation, and security mapping).

  • Transformation Stewardship: Driving the organizational shift from reactive project delivery toward proactive product ownership, helping the business eliminate shadow processes and friction points across boundaries like Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report.

What You Bring

You combine a deep understanding of process modeling and enterprise platforms with a consultative leadership mindset, and you enjoy empowering teams in complex transformation initiatives.

You bring:

  • Several years of experience in functional analysis, business process design, or requirements engineering within modern enterprise suites (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Salesforce, Microsoft Business Central).

  • Proven experience in a leadership or chapter lead role, with a strong passion for mentoring, team development, and resource management.

  • Deep methodological expertise in BPMN 2.0, Design Thinking, process decomposition, and defining end-to-end test scenarios.

  • Advanced tooling proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Signavio/Lucidchart/Miro, and UAT management platforms.

  • A solid understanding of core business domains such as accounting, supply chain, procurement, or digital retail.

  • Exceptional diplomatic and analytical facilitation skills; the confidence to constructively challenge business requests and guide stakeholders toward standard solutions.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working with a clear understanding of cross-system architecture boundaries.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

jobs.title: Defense Success Manager, France
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Defense Success Manager, you own what happens to our most strategic defense and sovereign accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows — often in restricted or disconnected environments — keep production commitments healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals that Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams (Deployment Strategists and Forward Deployed Engineers) co-create high-value AI use cases with customers in these environments. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, demonstrating its impact, and scaling value across the institution. You will work with mission owners, program stakeholders, end users, security and IT teams, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep — typically one or two flagship accounts plus a small number of adjacent programs. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex and constrained deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows. Travel to customer sites, including secure facilities, is a regular part of the job.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship programs while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the evidence that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout.


What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience owning outcomes for enterprise or institutional customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

  • Strong technical fluency in secure enterprise deployment models. You can identify what a deployment type (on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped) means for available features, telemetry, upgrades and accreditation, and you validate specifics with technical teams instead of assuming parity.

  • Ability to engage credibly with architects, engineers, IT and security stakeholders, while translating technical trade-offs into clear implications for mission owners and executives. You know when to bring in a deeper technical expert.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance and confidentiality constraints, including restricted or classified environments and strict information-handling rules.

  • Strong ownership and builder energy. You have created structure or improved a process in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and are motivated to build a company, not wait for clear directions.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and execution skills. You align teams without formal authority, surface risks early and drive decisions through to completion

  • Analytical and commercially minded: you can define meaningful success metrics with imperfect data, assess customer health, and are comfortable carrying renewal and NRR accountability.


Nice to have

  • Experience serving defense, public sector or critical infrastructure customers, including sovereign or classified programs.

  • Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms or complex enterprise software, including production deployments in regulated or security-sensitive environments.

  • Experience working alongside deployment, engineering or professional services teams on custom use cases, and the transition from implementation to ongoing operation.

  • Familiarity with public procurement, framework agreements and multi-year option structures.

Security & Compliance criteria

  • Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

  • Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance (e.g. no criminal record, fulfillment of national service obligations).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward.

Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence.

You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with Programme, Project Leaders and sponsors to understand the strategic objectives and delivery requirements across the programme.

  • Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication.

  • Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery.

  • Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate.

  • Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles.

  • Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones.

  • Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves.

  • Identify and manage risks across the programme, working with team leads to mitigate blockers before they affect delivery.

  • Coordinate joint governance bodies (steering committees, working groups, technical committees) — agendas, materials, minutes and follow-ups — and ensure decisions are documented and actioned.

  • Communicate status clearly to internal leadership and external partners, surfacing decisions and trade-offs as they arise.

  • Maintain project documentation, decision logs and operational hygiene to a standard that supports a multi-year, partnered effort.

  • Coordinate resource allocation and operational support across the computational and wet lab teams where required.

  • Identify and embed improvements to ways of working as the programme evolves.

Professionally, you will have

  • A degree in life sciences, project management, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent industry experience welcome.

  • Significant Programme/Project management experience in biotech, pharma, or comparable scientific R&D settings, ideally including early-stage discovery programmes (target ID through to candidate selection), sufficient to operate as the senior Project manager for a major, multi-year effort.

  • Comfort managing a programme where scope and workstreams may evolve significantly as science matures from exploratory biology through to a defined lead series.

  • Scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly with discussions spanning wet lab biology, single-cell omics, and machine learning, and enough grounding in the discovery pipeline (target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimisation) to track progress and flag risk without needing to do the science yourself.

  • Familiarity with stage-gate or portfolio governance frameworks as applied to early discovery programmes (e.g. go/no-go criteria, TPP evolution, milestone-based progression).

  • Experience overseeing third-party or outsourced work packages (e.g. CROs, academic collaborators, specialist service providers) — tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality against agreed scope, and escalating issues appropriately.

  • Fluency with modern project management methodologies, artifacts and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira; Gantt, RAID logs).

  • Strong organisational skills with a record of managing complex, interdependent works treams in matrixed environments. Comfort with the operational realities of R&D projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clearly for senior external audiences.

    Bonus Experience:

  • Awareness of the discovery-to-IND pathway and its major inflection points (IND-enabling tox, CMC/formulation, DMPK, regulatory strategy) sufficient to anticipate future PM needs, even if this programme doesn't reach that stage during the role's tenure.

  • Any exposure to pre-IND regulatory interactions or translational/preclinical handover

Personally, you

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve.

We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust. 

You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems.

Your overall responsibilities include

  • Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop;

  • Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis;

  • Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices


Who we are looking for

In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters.

Additionally, you tick the following boxes:

  • You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience.

  • You have previous experience in the payments domain.

  • You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment.

  • You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases.

  • You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka.

  • You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build.

  • You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket.

  • You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement.

  • You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission.

Nice to have

  • Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place.

Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry!

As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure.

Our benefits package includes:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned).

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use.

  • Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations.

  • Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees.

  • Other perks include flexible working hours, full travel compensation and the working gear of your choice.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you!

Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your motivation letter why you’re excited about joining Fastned.

jobs.description:
About RhymeQ

RhymeQ is on a mission to make quantum programmable for every developer. Today, developing quantum software often requires deep physics expertise and code tailored to specific hardware. We’re removing these barriers so developers can focus on solving problems.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, we bring together an international team with an open mindset, an energetic team spirit, and a shared drive to build something that matters. We value initiative, ownership, and collaboration, giving everyone the space to contribute ideas, take responsibility, and help shape the future of quantum programming.

Your role

As our Developer Community Lead, you will help developers discover, write their first quantum program, and keep building. Your goal is to turn early interest into an active community where developers learn from one another, share projects, and contribute to the product’s development.

You will combine technical education, community building, and developer outreach. Working closely with our founders and engineering team, you will shape the community experience and grow the community internationally to our target size.

What you will do

  • Grow an active developer community: Build relationships with universities, programming communities, quantum organizations, and event organizers to attract developers to RHYME.
  • Help newcomers succeed: Create a clear onboarding journey, from registration and installation to running and sharing a first quantum program.
  • Build reasons to return: Organize onboarding cohorts, office hours, coding challenges, and hackathons that encourage continued learning and participation.
  • Create useful technical content: Develop tutorials, sample projects, livestreams, posts, and talks that make quantum programming approachable.
  • Support community contributions: Encourage developers to share their work, answer questions, and help others. Identify and support potential community ambassadors.
  • Connect developers with the product team: Turn questions, feedback, and recurring problems into clear recommendations for the compiler, tooling, and documentation.
  • Measure what works: Track acquisition, activation, retention, and contributions, and use the results to improve community programs.

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s in computer science, PhD is preferred.
  • Over 2 years of experience growing a developer community for a technical product, with results you can demonstrate through active users, downloads, contributors, event participation, or other relevant measures.
  • Practical Python skills. You can run code examples, lead a live tutorial, and help a newcomer troubleshoot their setup.
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and make learning engaging, whether in writing, on camera, or on stage.
  • Strong written and spoken English and confidence working with an international audience.
  • A self-driven approach: you can set priorities, organize programs, deliver them, and learn from the results.
  • An open, supportive communication style that helps developers feel comfortable asking questions and sharing unfinished work.
  • An understanding of quantum computing fundamentals, or the motivation to learn them quickly.

Your ability to build trust with developers, teach through code, and grow sustained participation matters most.

What we offer

  • Ownership from the start: Shape our community strategy, programs, and developer experience as our first community hire.
  • Direct collaboration with the founders: Work closely with the people building RHYME and bring developer needs into product decisions.
  • An open, international team: Share ideas, experiment, and learn alongside colleagues who value initiative and collaboration.
  • Visible impact: Help developers move from curiosity about quantum computing to building their own applications.
  • Remote work within Europe.

About the role

As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service.

What you’ll do:

  • Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product.

  • Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions.

  • Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day.

  • Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly.

  • Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call.

  • Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on.

What you'll need:

  • 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches.

  • You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams.

  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits.

  • A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products.

  • You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes.

This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team.

  • Generous start-up equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch provided in the office

  • Team building events

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
