Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The opportunity

Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.

As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.

You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

  • Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

  • Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

  • Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

  • Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

  • Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

  • Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

  • Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

  • Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

  • A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

  • Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

  • The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

  • Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

  • Fluent English.

  • Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

Why BLP

  • Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

  • Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

  • A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

  • Employee participation plan.

How we work

  • Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

  • Transparency: We build trust through openness.

  • Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

  • Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

Practical information

  • Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

  • Employment: full-time, permanent.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

 

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

 

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

 
 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

 

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

 

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


How you'll empower our tech and product leadership

You be a strategic partner and a vital force multiplier for our Chief Product Officer, Tom (CPrO) and incoming Chief Technology Officer (CTO). By anticipating their needs, shaping their organisational engagement, and prioritising their diaries against company objectives, you will help turn their strategic vision into real momentum across the Product & Technology teams.

  • Owning the operating rhythm: You will proactively manage the executives' time and diaries, utilising your knowledge of Product Development Lifecycles and Engineering to effectively balance urgent requests with important strategic priorities.

  • Driving strategic communications: You will draft, shape, and constructively challenge key messaging from the executives, ensuring communications are clear, consistent, and land successfully with various audiences.

  • Preparing with a point of view: You will go beyond basic preparation by synthesising information, highlighting crucial details, and recommending decisions ahead of key meetings and board sessions.

  • Being the ear to the ground: You will stay attuned to team sentiment and blockers across Product & Technology, bringing insights to the executives early and advising on the best response.

  • Fostering an AI-native culture: You will partner with the executives and other Executive Assistants to design impactful cultural moments, such as hackathons and Town Hall meetings, ensuring momentum continues long after the events conclude.

  • Running the Product & Tech engine: You will oversee logistics for the Product & Tech Leadership forum, manage fast-changing schedules, and monitor asynchronous Slack conversations to highlight matters needing executive attention.

  • Delivering impactful projects and events: You will own and run projects on behalf of the executives from planning to delivery, while also managing the logistics for internal and external events, offsites, and team socials.


You should apply if...

  • You are an experienced Executive Assistant: You have previously supported Product, Tech, or Engineering leaders within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proactive forward-thinking is your natural state: You excel at thinking multiple steps ahead, actioning potential next steps before the executives have even considered them.

  • You're a critical prioritisation partner: You are a critical thinker who has the ability to challenge executives on their priorities, messaging, or plans to keep them focused on what matters.

  • You use AI as your teammate: You are confident leveraging AI tools, effective prompting, and automation to redefine how you work and find smarter ways to execute.

  • You're the master of diaries and complex logistics: You have excellent time-management skills, meticulous attention to detail, and a proven track record managing fast-changing schedules and team events under tight deadlines.

  • You have strong industry and business acumen: You understand how product and engineering organisations deliver, enabling you to help leaders balance the urgent with the important.

  • You're an empathetic, high-EQ communicator: You influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, read how change lands across an organisation, and adapt your communication style seamlessly.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £60,000 - £75,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £60K – £75K • Offers Equity

Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Analist – Rechtshulp (Synergy/Dynamics)

Assen | 38 uur | Schaal 10

Het mooie van werken bij Univé

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening? Ben jij een ervaren businessanalist die complexe processen doorgrondt, inhoudelijk richting geeft en graag zelf met beide benen in de praktijk staat?

Binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies werken we aan de migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics. Een uitdagende verandering waarbij niet alleen technologie, maar vooral onze bedrijfsprocessen en de dienstverlening aan onze leden centraal staan.

Als Senior Business Analist krijg jij de ruimte om deze verandering inhoudelijk vorm te geven. Je voert zelfstandig complexe analyses uit, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat businessbehoeften worden vertaald naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren businessanalist die overzicht houdt in complexe verandertrajecten. Je begrijpt hoe bedrijfsprocessen, informatievoorziening en IT-systemen samenhangen en weet deze kennis te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om collega's verder te helpen.

Je wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je neemt initiatief, stelt kritische vragen en durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe business- en procesanalyses binnen een IT-omgeving.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met zowel Synergy als Microsoft Dynamics.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen naar functionele requirements.

  • Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken zelfstandig uit te werken en anderen daarin mee te nemen.

  • Ervaring met het inhoudelijk begeleiden en coachen van collega-analisten.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en het verbinden van business en IT.

  • Kennis van Agile/Scrum en het werken in multidisciplinaire teams.

Ervaring met systeemmigraties, juridische dienstverlening of de verzekeringsbranche is een pré.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Business Analist werk je binnen het Rechtshulp Synergy-team aan de vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap voor onze juridische dienstverlening.

De migratie van Synergy naar Microsoft Dynamics vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw werkzaamheden.

Je brengt bestaande processen en informatievoorziening in kaart, onderzoekt welke verbeteringen mogelijk zijn en vertaalt deze naar heldere requirements voor de nieuwe omgeving.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt welke impact veranderingen hebben op medewerkers, processen en uiteindelijk onze leden.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Het zelfstandig uitvoeren van complexe business- en procesanalyses.

  • Het analyseren van bestaande Synergy-processen en het vertalen hiervan naar de gewenste inrichting binnen Dynamics.

  • Het ophalen, uitwerken en valideren van businessrequirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria.

  • Het inzichtelijk maken van afhankelijkheden tussen processen, applicaties en andere IT-teams.

  • Het adviseren van de Product Owner en businessstakeholders over oplossingsrichtingen en verbeterkansen.

  • Het inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere businessanalisten en bewaken van de kwaliteit van analyses.

  • Het ondersteunen bij de voorbereiding en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en de verdere professionalisering van businessanalyse.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Binnen de eerste zes maanden heb je de belangrijkste Rechtshulp-processen geanalyseerd en vertaald naar bruikbare requirements voor Dynamics.

Daarnaast heb je inhoudelijk richting gegeven aan de migratie en een zichtbare bijdrage geleverd aan de kwaliteit en zelfstandigheid van de andere analisten.

Je team

Je komt terecht in het Rechtshulp Synergy-team binnen de waardestroom Juridisch Advies.

Het team maakt onderdeel uit van IT Distributie, waar we nauw samenwerken met onze businesscollega's om de dienstverlening van Univé continu te verbeteren.

Je werkt in een team waarin medewerkers veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgen. We verwachten dat je zelfstandig kunt werken, initiatief toont en actief de samenwerking opzoekt.

Als senior krijg je een belangrijke inhoudelijke rol, zonder dat je formeel leidinggevende bent.

Je bent iemand bij wie collega's terechtkunnen voor complexe vraagstukken, maar die ook zelf graag de inhoud induikt.

Je standplaats is Assen.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Univé krijg je een uitdagende functie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan de digitale vernieuwing van onze juridische dienstverlening.

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je vakinhoudelijke kennis in te zetten en collega's verder te helpen.

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10.

Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar, op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

Daarnaast bieden we onder andere:

  • Een variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd.

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek.

  • Een goede studiekostenregeling en mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een goede pensioenvoorziening.

  • Vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken.

  • Korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatie zonder winstoogmerk. We helpen onze leden risico's te voorkomen, gevolgen te beperken en problemen op te lossen.

Binnen Juridisch Advies ondersteunen we leden bij juridische vragen en problemen. Goede digitale ondersteuning helpt onze collega's om deze dienstverlening persoonlijk, toegankelijk en efficiënt te houden.

IT Distributie speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. We ontwikkelen en verbeteren de IT-oplossingen waarmee onze collega's hun werk kunnen doen en onze leden goed geholpen worden.

Daarbij geloven we in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de ruimte om zelf verbeteringen aan te dragen.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met Synergy en Microsoft Dynamics inzetten om onze juridische dienstverlening toekomstbestendig te maken?

En krijg je energie van een rol waarin je complexe analyses combineert met het begeleiden van collega's?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Solliciteer op de functie van Senior Business Analist Rechtshulp bij Univé.

Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices.

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!

  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.

  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

Our Offer

  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.

jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented AIT Test Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that NYX can be integrated.

You will be successful in this role if you are able to help us:

  • Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external dynamic testing (vibration test, shock tests,...) of several sub-systems (electronic, fittings, weldings...) and internally developed prototypes

  • Prepare, execute and manage the internal or external thermal testing (cycling, TVAC...) of several sub-systems and internally developed prototypes

  • Write documentation prior and post integration and test activities

  • Prepare, execute and manage other testing activities in AIT domain (e.g.: parachute, EMC, mechanisms, Structural Test Model...)

  • Support mechanical integration activities needed on Nyx Capsule


Key Responsibilities

  • You will manage the testing activities from definition of requirements to post-test reviews

  • You will be responsible of writing, reviewing and executing procedures detailing the setups for integration and tests (in Epsilon3, ODOO, Team Center)

  • You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in-house with internal equipment (vibration test bench, thermal vacuum chamber, shock test rig, ...)

  • You will be responsible for the execution of the tests performed in external facilities

jobs.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Marseille, France
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

jobs.title: Director Of Development Benelux
jobs.description:
The Director of Development – Benelux plays a pivotal role in driving Leonardo Hotels’ expansion strategy across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.

This senior role is responsible for identifying, evaluating, structuring, and closing hotel development, conversion, and repositioning opportunities in line with the Group’s growth ambitions. The position requires strong commercial judgement, real estate expertise, financial sophistication, and the ability to build and manage senior-level relationships across a complex, mature hospitality market.

 

Main tasks

Development & Growth Strategy

  • Proactively source new hotel opportunities (existing assets, conversions, repositionings, and new developments) across the Benelux region.

  • Focus on urban and high-demand locations aligned with Leonardo Hotels’ target segments: corporate, MICE, leisure, and bleisure.

  • Build, manage, and prioritise a robust development pipeline in line with agreed growth targets.

 

Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning

  • Analyse market fundamentals including demand drivers, RevPAR performance, competitive landscape, pipeline supply, and destination growth trends.

  • Identify strategic opportunities in both core cities and high-potential secondary markets.

  • Provide regular insights and recommendations to senior leadership on market dynamics and competitive positioning.

  • Ensure brand alignment by matching each opportunity to the appropriate Leonardo brand and operational model.

 

Deal Origination & Execution

  • Lead the full deal lifecycle from origination through to contract execution.

  • Conduct feasibility studies, including financial modelling, cash flow projections, and return analyses.

  • Structure and negotiate commercial terms with property owners, developers, asset managers, and institutional investors.

  • Prepare investment memoranda, development proposals, and brand presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Oversee and support due diligence processes (technical, legal, financial, and operational).

 

Relationship Management - Develop and maintain strong relationships with:

  • Property owners and developers

  • Real estate funds and institutional investors

  • Local brokers and advisory firms

  • Banking partners and hospitality consultants

  • Represent Leonardo Hotels at industry events and networking platforms within the Benelux region.

 

Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Work closely with operations, technical services, finance, legal, and brand teams to ensure feasibility and alignment.

  • Present business cases to senior management and support internal approval processes.

  • Ensure a smooth transition from signed deal to pre-opening and operational handover, safeguarding brand standards and commercial objectives.

LEONARDO HOTELS BENELUX

Leonardo Hotels Benelux is part of the Leonardo Hotels Group and manages a portfolio of 29 hotels across the Netherlands and Belgium.

At Leonardo Hotels, we believe in growing together, making an impact, and creating meaningful connections. Our colleagues stay with us for an average of four years -  something we’re very proud of - thanks to the opportunities we offer to develop and grow.

You’ll be working closely with the marketing team, gaining exposure to real campaigns and strategies within an international hospitality brand.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Hospitality, Finance, or related field; MBA is a plus.

  • Proven track record in negotiating and closing hotel management and/or lease agreements.

  • Advanced financial modelling and feasibility analysis capabilities.

  • In-depth knowledge of: Hotel P&L structures, Lease and management agreements, Conversion and repositioning strategies

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, Dutch and French.

  • Your home based is in The Netherlands is a must

  • Comfortable operating in an international, matrix organisation.

  • Willingness to travel regularly within the Benelux region.

jobs.title: Account Executive DACH
jobs.description:
Are you prepared to fuel the growth of an exciting scale-up that's transforming the logistics industry? Do you thrive on building strategic relationships and creating new opportunities and closing complex deals? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Logistics? Maybe not what you dreamed of as a kid. But building a fast-growing international SaaS scale-up that's transforming how some of the world's largest industrial companies operate? That's a different story.

Peripass is a tech company at heart. We build software that digitises and automates complex logistics environments for companies like Bridgestone, Alpro and ArcelorMittal. These companies have hundreds of trucks loading and unloading every month, and our SaaS platform helps them orchestrate that whole process. Peripass is a high-impact SaaS platform used in international enterprise environments.

Want to be part of this adventure? As an Account Executive Germany within the Sales Team, you will have a front-row seat to the growth of an international SaaS scale-up and play a key role in expanding our presence in the German market.

  • Own the full sales cycle: You will be responsible for selling our SaaS solution and independently managing qualified sales opportunities from initial engagement through signed contract. This includes identifying and qualifying prospects, conducting discovery conversations, developing business cases, managing stakeholders, negotiating and closing deals.

  • Build our presence in Germany: Identify target accounts and create new business opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting and personalised outreach across relevant industries. Work closely with our BDR team to open conversations with new prospects and build awareness of Peripass in the German market.

  • Pipeline momentum and sales velocity: Proactively collaborate with internal stakeholders and customer champions to maintain momentum, reduce sales cycles, and improve win rates. This involves consistent follow-ups, addressing blockers, and aligning on goals.

  • Existing customer growth: Identify opportunities for cross-selling and selling to additional sites within existing customer accounts, in close collaboration with Customer Success and other relevant teams.

  • Deal negotiation and closing: Take commercial leadership in deal negotiation and closure, ensuring alignment with the prospect's needs while achieving company revenue and margin goals. This includes handling objections and finalising contracts.

  • Travel across Germany: the role involves travelling approximately two to three days per week within Germany to meet prospects and customers.

  • Work from our new German office: We are soon opening a new office in Hamburg.

  • Visit our Ghent HQ approximately every six weeks to connect with your colleagues. To get you fully acquainted with your colleagues, you'll also get an in-depth onboarding at our HQ during your first two weeks.

  • You will report directly to our GTM Lead, who is looking forward to coaching you extensively as you build the German market and grow your career at Peripass.

What we offer

  • Front-row seat to scale-up growth: Be part of the next growth phase of Peripass in the German and have a direct impact on building our market presence.

  • Opportunity in a growing market: Be part of a fast-scaling SaaS company revolutionising yard management in logistics, with the opportunity to make an impact in Germany.

  • Uncapped earning potential: A competitive salary with a commission plan that truly rewards success. The more you close, the more you earn.

  • Ownership and freedom: Take charge of your pipeline and strategy. We trust you to drive results, with the flexibility to work how and where you perform best.

  • Backed by a strong team: From BDR and marketing to pre-sales and Customer Success, you'll have a strong team behind you, helping you create, close and grow opportunities.

  • A role with real impact: Help shape our German sales approach, market strategy and way of working as the team and market continue to grow.

  • Awesome office in the heart of Hamburg with a dedicated team, combined with travel to clients and the option to work from home.


Come on, blow us away with your credentials! 💥 You will if you have:

  • At least five years of work experience, including two years of relevant experience owning a full sales cycle.

  • Experience working in a high-growth environment, preferably in SaaS or a similar context.

  • Experience managing complex decision-making units and closing deals of a comparable size.

  • Hunter mindset: You are not afraid of outbound sales or creating opportunities from scratch. Working in a scale-up means that you are willing to hunt, generate leads and actively open doors with new prospects. Of course, you will be supported by our BDR team, but mindset is key!

  • Strong stakeholder management skills for complex decision-making units and sales processes in international corporate environments.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unsere Mission bei Drevise

Die Fertigungsindustrie bildet das Fundament unserer modernen Welt. Doch während künstliche Intelligenz ganze Branchen verändert, arbeiten Ingenieure und Fertigungsexperten noch immer mit fragmentierten Systemen, manuellen Prozessen und Wissen, das über unzählige Dokumente und Unternehmen verteilt ist. Wir bei Drevise wollen das grundlegend verändern.

Wir arbeiten an einer Zukunft, in der technisches Wissen nicht länger in einzelnen Systemen und Köpfen verborgen bleibt, sondern intelligent miteinander vernetzt wird. Dafür entwickeln wir eine KI-Plattform, die technische Produktdaten versteht, Experten unterstützt und Unternehmen miteinander verbindet. Unser Ziel: Die Art und Weise neu definieren, wie Produkte weltweit entwickelt, gefertigt und auf den Markt gebracht werden.

Unser Team will mehr, als nur einen Job zu machen: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Grenzen, übernehmen Verantwortung und bauen gemeinsam etwas auf, das bleibt. Wer bei Drevise einsteigt, gestaltet nicht nur ein Unternehmen mit, sondern die Zukunft einer der wichtigsten Industrien der Welt.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) begleitest du unsere Kunden vom Onboarding bis in den Arbeitsalltag und sorgst dafür, dass Drevise dort messbaren Mehrwert schafft. Du verantwortest deine Kunden, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale früh und baust unsere Customer-Success-Organisation von Anfang an mit auf.

  • Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse und Herausforderungen und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.

  • Du begleitest neue Kunden beim Onboarding und stellst sicher, dass sie unsere Lösungen erfolgreich einsetzen und echten Mehrwert erzielen.

  • Du beantwortest Kundenanfragen schnell und lösungsorientiert, koordinierst technische Fragestellungen und sorgst für eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen, förderst die aktive Nutzung unserer Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit.

  • Gemeinsam mit unserem Product Team entwickelst du Hilfeartikel, Guides und Trainings, um unsere Kunden bestmöglich zu unterstützen.

  • Du sammelst Kundenfeedback, identifizierst wiederkehrende Anforderungen und bringst diese aktiv in unsere Produktentwicklung ein.

  • Du begleitest Bestandskunden bei der Einführung und Erprobung neuer Funktionen – von der Planung bis zur Auswertung.

Qualifikationen

  • Du bringst mindestens 1–2 Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder technischen Support mit – idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Du hast ein gutes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, dich tief in komplexe Produkte und Prozesse einzuarbeiten.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Fertigung, im Engineering oder Qualitätsmanagement sind ein klarer Pluspunkt.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe – mit Ingenieuren genauso wie mit Geschäftsführern.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei mehreren Kunden den Überblick und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung.

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description:
Your mission

Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, you own how customers on both sides activate, buy and stay. You decide which signals matter and what should happen next, and a Growth Engineer builds the system with you. You'll be one of the first hires in a lean marketing team and shape how it works as it grows. We're looking for someone ambitious: you think in systems that sense, decide and learn, not in a handful of fixed, old-school email journeys.

What you'll do

• Define the lifecycle and signal strategy for general contractors and subcontractors: the key stages and behaviours, and the signals that predict activation, repeat usage, expansion or churn.

• Turn those signals into playbooks: prioritized interventions, segments and messages, coordinated with Sales and Customer Success where a human touch works better.

• Drive subcontractor activation, conversion to Premium and churn prevention, and contractor adoption and retention, including 1:1 logic on enriched account data.

• Prove what works with cohort baselines, A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions rest on incremental impact, not campaign output.

• Build a signal-driven system with the Growth Engineer that decides what happens next, starting from a prioritized signal-to-action map.

• Later, build retention and referral programmes and help hire a second Lifecycle Manager.

What you bring

• You've owned lifecycle, CRM, retention or growth programmes and can show their commercial impact, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business.

• You're ambitious and think big: you design lifecycle as a system that adapts to each customer, not as a set of fixed drip journeys that get tweaked once a quarter.

• You're data-driven: you've moved activation, conversion or retention metrics and you read experiment results critically.

• You're technically fluent: you've worked with an engineer on a complex system with solid tracking and solved problems from the implementation side.

• You're AI-native: you've built AI-driven automation into a real journey, not only used AI to write copy faster.

• You get things done, learn fast and are comfortable building from scratch.

• You work well across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering.

• Fluent English; German is a big plus. Experience with ActiveCampaign or Salesforce is a plus.

Your benefits

• Room to shape and grow: one of the first marketing hires, with real ownership of lifecycle and CRM on both sides of the platform.

• AI at the core: our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better, and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast.

• Competitive compensation: salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

• Work-life balance: fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

• Top-notch equipment: a new MacBook Pro.

• A great team: open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

• Growth and feedback: open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno is a fast-growing tech company making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with its digital platform for tenders and procurement. Our goal: to solve the industry's most complex challenges with innovation and simplicity. Join us and build the future of construction.

Compensation: €65K – €85K

jobs.title: IT Administrator - (Senior) IT Administrator
jobs.description:
Apex.AI is an international software company developing safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility and autonomous systems. Our technology enables companies to build software-defined vehicles and intelligent machines faster, safer, and more efficiently. 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Administrator / (Senior) IT Administrator to take ownership of the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of our IT environment in Germany while supporting our international teams. 

This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, administering systems, supporting users, and continuously improving IT infrastructure. You will work across Linux and macOS endpoints, identity and access management, cloud services, networks, security tooling, and on-premises infrastructure. 

You will be a key point of contact for IT topics in our Munich office and work closely with Engineering, DevOps, HR, and other business functions. 

In addition to your core IT responsibilities, you will have the opportunity to develop your knowledge of Information Security and compliance, including ISO 27001 and TISAX. Previous compliance experience is welcome but not required—we are looking for someone who is interested in learning and growing in this area. 

As Apex.AI grows, this role offers the opportunity to take on broader ownership and help shape the future of our IT function. 

 
This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany is required.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on IT Administration 

  • Own and manage the day-to-day operation of our cloud and on-premises IT environment.  

  • Administer and support Linux and macOS endpoints throughout their lifecycle.  

  • Manage MDM, IAM, user accounts, permissions, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Administer cloud-based email, collaboration, and file-storage services.  

  • Manage employee access across internal systems and business applications.  

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot wired and wireless networks.  

  • Manage VPN solutions, network segmentation, policies, and access rules.  

  • Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud-based servers.  

  • Manage endpoint security solutions, including EDR/antivirus, patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Implement and maintain integrations between different IT systems.  

  • Automate repetitive IT administration tasks wherever possible.  

  • Monitor systems and proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact users.  

    • IT Support & Service Delivery 

  • Be a primary point of contact for IT support for employees in our Munich office and provide remote support to colleagues in other locations.  

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, endpoint, network, account, and access issues.  

  • Manage IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved efficiently.  

  • Set up laptops, accounts, permissions, and required applications for new employees.  

  • Execute IT onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors.  

  • Manage IT hardware inventory and device lifecycle.  

  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.  

  • Help create a reliable and user-friendly IT environment where employees can work effectively with minimal friction.  

    • IT Security & Compliance 

    You will have the opportunity to learn how to manage ISMS based on ISO 27001 and TISAX frameworks. We are looking for someone eager to develop in this area. 

    You will: 

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of technical security controls.  

  • Help maintain IT documentation, policies, procedures, asset inventories, and access records.  

  • Support evidence collection and technical preparation for ISO 27001 and TISAX audits.  

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders on Information Security topics.  

  • Support vulnerability management, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and security incident readiness.  

  • Help investigate and resolve IT security incidents.  

  • Gradually develop your knowledge of our ISMS and security/compliance requirements.  

  • Contribute ideas for improving the security and resilience of our IT environment.  

    • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

  • Work closely with Engineering and DevOps on infrastructure, access, networking, and security topics.  

  • Support business applications used by HR, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other teams.  

  • Work with IT vendors and service providers when required.  

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to our IT environment.  

  • Support the secure adoption of AI tools and emerging technologies.  

  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and simplification.  


    • What you bring

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an IT Administrator, System Administrator, IT Engineer, or similar role.  

  • Strong hands-on experience administering Linux and/or macOS environments, with a willingness to become proficient across both.  

  • Experience with endpoint and device management, including MDM, centralized patching, encryption, and security policies.  

  • Experience with IAM, SSO, and MFA.  

  • Experience administering cloud-based productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365.  

  • Solid networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, VPNs, VLANs, and firewalls.  

  • Experience administering servers and working with on-premises infrastructure.  

  • Understanding of endpoint security, backups, monitoring, and logging.  

  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.  

  • A practical troubleshooting mindset and willingness to investigate problems independently.  

  • Comfortable supporting users directly—from simple endpoint issues to more complex infrastructure problems.  

  • Ability to document technical processes clearly.  

  • Fluent English; German language skills are a must (C1 level).  


    • For the Senior IT Administrator level

    Candidates considered for the Senior IT Administrator level should additionally bring:

  • 5+ years of relevant hands-on IT administration or systems engineering experience, ideally in a technical or engineering-driven environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise across Linux and macOS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex endpoint and system issues.
  • Proven experience taking ownership of MDM, IAM, SSO/MFA, endpoint security, networking, and access management.
  • Strong networking knowledge with practical experience configuring and troubleshooting VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, Wi-Fi, and firewalls.
  • Experience independently owning technical projects from solution design and implementation through documentation and ongoing operation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, networks, cloud services, identity, and infrastructure, with the ability to resolve complex issues without relying primarily on external providers.
  • Experience using scripting and automation to improve IT operations and reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Ability to proactively identify weaknesses in an existing IT environment and independently propose and implement secure, scalable improvements.
  • Experience acting as a technical escalation point and supporting or mentoring less experienced colleagues.
  • Ability to work confidently with Engineering and DevOps teams and communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • A strong security mindset and interest in taking increasing ownership of Information Security, ISO 27001, TISAX, and ISMS-related topics.

    • Previous hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, TISAX, an ISMS, or security audits is an advantage for the Senior level, but not required.

    Most importantly, you: 

  • Enjoy being hands-on and solving technical problems yourself.  

  • Take ownership instead of simply escalating issues to someone else.  

  • Are comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask for help.  

  • Enjoy working with highly technical software engineers and learning from subject-matter experts.  

  • Are curious about new technologies and continuously develop your skills.  

  • Want to broaden your experience beyond traditional IT administration into Information Security, ISO 27001, and TISAX.  

    •  


    Nice to have

  • Experience with JumpCloud or similar MDM/IAM platforms.  

  • Experience with Google Workspace administration.  

  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EBS, IAM, or RDS.  

  • Experience with EDR, vulnerability management, monitoring, or logging solutions.  

  • Experience supporting developer or engineering environments.  

  • Familiarity with CI/CD infrastructure and version-control systems.  

  • Previous exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, ISMS, or security audits.  

  • IT or security certifications such as CompTIA, ITIL, CCNA, or similar.  

  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM technologies and their secure use within an enterprise environment.  


    • Why Apex.AI

  • Take real ownership of a modern IT environment rather than simply managing external providers.  

  • Work closely with world-class software engineers developing cutting-edge platforms for autonomous and software-defined systems.  

  • Gain hands-on exposure to an engineering-focused environment spanning Linux, macOS, cloud, networking, security, and developer infrastructure.  

  • Grow your Information Security expertise through practical exposure to ISO 27001, TISAX, security controls, audits, and ISMS processes.  

  • Have a direct impact on how our IT environment evolves as the company grows.  

  • Work in an international, engineering-driven culture where technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.  

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for professional and career development.  

    • About Apex.AI

    Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A, the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff – Corporate Affairs (f/m/d): the first point of contact and the engine room of our Corporate Affairs unit. You will report directly to our Chief Corporate Affairs Officer (CCAO) and run the day-to-day work that keeps a growing, cross-border agenda coherent and moving. This frees the CCAO to focus on relationships and strategy.

You will own ambiguous, cross-functional execution independently. Strategic positioning and external representation remain with the CCAO.

What You'll Do

  • Own the CCAO's agenda and priorities, acting as her first point of contact internally and externally.

  • Drive project management for Corporate Affairs initiatives across Brussels, Berlin, Hesse, and international markets, including tracking dependencies and milestones across locations.

  • Run planning, OKR, and reporting processes for the unit on a reliable cadence.

  • Build decision-ready briefings, talking points, and papers for senior management and the Board, prepared ahead of need.

  • Prepare and follow up on meetings with government bodies, EU institutions, parliament, and industry associations.

  • Partner with the CEO Office, Finance, Investor Relations, Legal, and technical teams on cross-functional initiatives.

  • Manage relationships with external partners such as agencies and advisors.

  • Enable rapid, coordinated responses to short-notice political and stakeholder developments.

What You Bring

  • Proven senior-level experience in chief of staff, executive support, corporate affairs, public affairs, or government relations roles.

  • Solid understanding of political processes at federal, state, and EU level, and of public affairs fundamentals. Interest in energy and technology policy is a plus.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to keep many cross-market threads moving without dropping details.

  • Experience with OKR-based planning, stakeholder mapping, and cross-functional coordination, plus confidence with planning and project management tools.

  • Clear, precise written communication in English and German, with a focus on decisions. You prepare materials that senior leaders and the Board can act on without rework.

  • Ownership and initiative: you anticipate needs, flag issues before they are asked about, and take full accountability for the unit's execution.

  • Sound judgment on operational decisions such as scheduling, sequencing, and partner management, with the ability to work without close supervision.

  • Discretion and confidentiality in handling sensitive political, regulatory, and Board-level information.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to Brussels and Berlin.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a scale-up or early-growth company.

  • Experience in energy, fusion, or other deep-tech sectors.

  • Experience with EU-level, parliamentary, or industry association engagement.

  • Experience supporting a C-level executive in a cross-border organization.

What We Offer

Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs, whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing. You choose what fits your lifestyle.

Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.
